info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Payments-v3-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Payments Retrieval API enables users to efficiently access detailed payment information related to educational enrollments. This endpoint allows for the retrieval of payment records which can be crucial for educational institutions and administrators to track financial transactions linked to student enrollments. Typical users include educational institutions, finance departments, and application developers seeking to integrate payment data into their systems. This API supports streamlined access to essential payment insights, facilitating better financial management and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed payment information related to student enrollments, including status, amount, and transaction details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the payment process for enrollments. It should contain the necessary details to process the payment including payment methods, amount, and any associated enrollment identifiers.

200.description: Successful retrieval of payment enrollment information.

ListEducationEnrollmentsPaymentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to enrollments and payment. It is expected to contain a JSON string that encapsulates the payment enrollment details.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the payment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional details about the operation.

ListEducationEnrollmentsPaymentsResponse.description: Response schema for the GET payment operation, providing details about the operation's success and its associated audit information.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the payment.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the payment was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment process was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the payment operation, containing details about its creator and creation time.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
